summary: Learn inclusive urban service design, accessibility and civic technology pilot planning. Explore the course and develop a practical roadmap.
lede: Smart city design training helps urban planners and public service teams turn resident needs into inclusive technology pilots. Participants map service journeys, assess digital accessibility and compare technology options against service needs. They also develop pilot scopes, consider data stewardship and interoperability, and define indicators to track outcomes across urban services.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level smart city training suits professionals who shape public-facing urban services, select digital interventions or coordinate city innovation. It is designed for roles that need to connect user needs, inclusive design and practical technology decisions.
modules: Open Data Charter Urban Data Practice
UN New Urban Agenda Implementation Roadmaps
prerequisites: Prior experience with smart city systems or digital service design is not required. Familiarity with urban services or public-sector project work will help you connect the exercises to your role. Coding or programming is not required; advanced topics such as OGC API Features receive conceptual coverage.
